summary: More than most people, a fast, restless mind and a strong will and deep reserves of energy are fused in you — you can't run one without the other. At your best, you think and talk your way through anything and you go after what you want and don't back down. At the edge, you overthink it, or talk when you should feel.
body: More than most people, a fast, restless mind and a strong will and deep reserves of energy are fused in you — you can't run one without the other. At your best, you think and talk your way through anything and you go after what you want and don't back down. At the edge, you overthink it, or talk when you should feel. Fast, cutting thinking; the task is channeling the edge productively.
gift: At your best: you think and talk your way through anything, and you go after what you want and don't back down.
shadow: The trap: you overthink it, or talk when you should feel — or your temper gets ahead of you, or you sit on it until it leaks out sideways.
integration: Let thinking and speech and drive and anger cooperate without making either one carry the whole story. Fast, cutting thinking; the task is channeling the edge productively.
do: Use it on purpose, not on reflex
Let you think and you go after what you want work together
When it spikes, name it before you act
dont: Let the reflex make the decision
